thread:
maria: Heads-up — opened docs PR that adds an "edge connector" guide for mTLS proxy chaining and a lightweight kube-profile for constrained on-prem nodes. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5023 :eyes:

maria: The PR also includes an example offline bundle for air-gapped installs and a short KMS/HSM PKCS11 snippet, but I haven't added the Windows network example yet.

devon: Nice. Quick skim: the nftables example uses a user chain name `RW_EDGE` which isn't referenced elsewhere in the doc. Could we stick to `redwood-egress` so it matches other examples? small nit.

samir: Re: KMS snippet — PKCS11 env var example looks good but we should call out slot indexing differences for SoftHSM vs hardware HSMs. Suggest adding this block: 

```bash
# connector install (airgapped, PKCS11 HSM)
redwoodctl install \
  --profile edge-light \
  --airgap /tmp/offline-bundle.tar.gz \
  --kms pkcs11 \
  --pkcs11-module /opt/pkcs11/libpkcs11.so \
  --pkcs11-slot 1
  --pkcs11-pin-file /etc/redwood/pkcs11-pin
```

samir: And a note: "If you see CKR_SLOT_ID_INVALID, try slot index 0 or run `pkcs11-tool --list-slots` on the host to enumerate slots."

elaine: I'll add a Windows netsh egress rule example. Draft: 

```powershell
# Allow outbound to KMS host on 443
netsh advfirewall firewall add rule name=\"RedwoodKMS\" dir=out action=allow remoteip=10.2.3.5 protocol=TCP remoteport=443
```

elaine: Also want the doc to mention corporate proxies that rewrite SNI — that's been a gotcha for a customer.

maria: Good catches. Devon, can you rename chain to `redwood-egress` and drop a one-liner about nftables/iptables parity?

devon: Yup, will push a small commit to the PR in a bit.

docs-bot: docs lint results for PR #5023 — heading IDs and a couple of dead links detected: `./install/offline-bundle.md#bundle-verification` is 404.

maria: Thanks docs-bot. The broken link points to `bundle-verification` anchor — I changed headings while reorganizing. I'll add the anchor back and include `sha256sum` verification snippet: 

```bash
# verify offline bundle checksum
sha256sum -c redwood-offline-bundle.tar.gz.sha256 || echo "Checksum mismatch"
```

samir: CI smoke (staging deploy) looks okay but noticed systemd unit on some constrained VMs fails because `/etc/resolv.conf` is a symlink to busybox resolver path. We should add a troubleshooting note: "Ensure resolv.conf is writable or use static DNS in the connector config."

sre-bot: Staging deployment for docs PR #5023 completed — connector smoke tests: 11/12 green, DNS resolution flake seen on `vm-004`.

maria: OK we'll add the resolv.conf note and a fallback example using `--dns 8.8.8.8` in the CLI.

elaine: Also flagged UX: screenshots include the old Console nav path (Settings > Integrations) — Console changed to (Platform > Connectors). I'll update the screenshot and the alt text.

maria: Assigning reviewers: @devon, @elaine, @samir. If we can get review + small fixes today, aim to merge tomorrow morning and cut a docs release.

docs-bot: PR #5023 updated, lint rerun queued.

sre-bot: CI re-run: 12/12 green on staging. Ready to merge after approvals. :white_check_mark:

maria: Great — thanks all. I'll merge once approvals land. If anyone has a quick test cluster, please try the `edge-light` profile and confirm `redwoodctl status` shows `connector: healthy`.

devon: Will test on `lab-edge-2` in ~30m.

samir: I can validate PKCS11 flow on SoftHSM and one hardware device tomorrow morning.

elaine: I'll finish the Windows snippets and send a follow-up PR if needed.

maria: Closing out here — will update release notes with the new 'Edge connector' guide and the migration bullet for customers moving from the old `proxy` profile to `edge-light`. :rocket:
